summary_en: Annual dividend raised to ¥136/share (FY3/27 full year) from ¥130 guidance: mid-term ¥68 (+¥3), year-end ¥68 (+¥3). Payout ratio not disclosed. 12th consecutive increase. Revision driven by upgraded FY3/27 net income guidance (¥12,050M vs ¥11,000M prior) on better-than-expected oil product margins despite Middle East supply tensions.
title_en: Notice on Revision of Consolidated Financial Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On 6 August 2026, the board of KAMEI CORPORATION resolved to raise its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending 31 March 2027. The annual dividend per share is now projected at ¥136 (from ¥130 previously guided on 14 May 2026), comprising an interim dividend of ¥68 and a year-end dividend of ¥68. This represents a ¥3 increase in each of the interim and year-end components and marks the 12th consecutive year of dividend increases.

The revision reflects an upward adjustment to consolidated net income attributable to parent shareholders, now forecast at ¥12,050 million (from ¥11,000 million), driven by stronger-than-expected profitability. The company attributed this improvement to stable supply and appropriate cost pass-through of petroleum products despite elevated crude oil prices caused by tensions in the Middle East. Full-year operating profit is now expected at ¥17,890 million (vs. ¥15,700 million) and ordinary profit at ¥19,570 million (vs. ¥17,500 million).

The dividend policy, as stated, prioritizes sustained progressive dividend payments while maintaining a sound balance sheet and appropriate retained earnings, informed by consolidated results and payout ratios.
